# Python deps for the OfficeBench app/eval image (faithful to OfficeBench docker/requirements.txt,
# plus pytz which utils/evaluate.py needs).  The image only runs the official `apps` action modules
# and the official `utils/evaluate.py` checkers, so the networky/intercode-only deps (docker, rpyc,
# mysql-connector, gymnasium, rich) are dropped to keep the build lean.
fire
pandas
python-docx
openpyxl
tabulate
Pillow
PyMuPDF
PyPDF2
pdf2docx
pytesseract
icalendar
pytz
openai==0.28.1
